appearance.extreme: Their ribcage is a drum. When they speak, glass hums, and the sound arrives in your chest before it reaches your ears.
appearance.obvious: Their chest is barrelled out around something, and their voice carries a resonance that sits wrong in your ears.
appearance.subtle: Their voice has an odd second note under it.

description: A resonating chamber has grown behind your sternum. What comes out of it is not a shout, and people who hear it stop being able to stand up straight.
drawbacks: It hurts you to use it too
name: Sonic Organ
